name: [UPD]Verity Evolution
desc:
Start as a little smiley. Fight enemies and evolve into bigger, stranger forms.

32 forms across 4 worlds. Hatch pets, collect gear, take on bosses, and rebirth to get stronger.

PC: Click/F to attack, Q for auto attack, E to interact.
Mobile: Use the buttons on screen.
Controller: RT/R2 to attack, Y/Triangle for auto attack, X/Square to interact.

llm.loop: start as a smiley -> fight enemies to evolve into 32 forms -> hatch pets and collect gear -> beat bosses and rebirth across 4 worlds
llm.objectives: evolve into the final form across 4 worlds
llm.thumbnails: smiley face being eaten / evolving into 32 forms; explore 4 worlds
